notes.title: Welcome Newbies!
notes.content:
Sup new players-

Whether you downloaded the demo, got the game during the Fall Sale, or else stumbled across us some other way, we want to make you feel welcome in our spinny robot dimension. 

A little bit about us: DreamSail Games is an indie studio located in NYC. Blade Ballet is our first released game, it's our little robot child we've developed over the past year after hammering out the spinning mechanic at PAX one night. 

One of the best ways to enjoy Blade Ballet is joining our Discord server: that's where we devs hang out and where the majority of the community finds each other. It's also the best place to stick bug reports or give us feedback. [discord.gg/bladeballet]

Through the Discord you'll stay in the know about events that our community manager (booshumew/springknome) throws such as streams, tournaments, and giveaways. We also put these events on the Steam community hub event calendar so you get pinged when they start if you've followed Blade Ballet in the hub: [http://steamcommunity.com/app/460750]

To answer a few common questions/concerns:
-The matchmaking pool can be notoriously iffy. You may find it difficult to find a match if you just dive in any ol' time due to having a small player pool. This is of course something we want to change, and it will as we bring new people to the game, as you bring new people to the game, and as the community blossoms. So if you think the game has potential, grab some friends to download the demo and test it out!

-There is no single player mode yet, it's a local and online multiplayer game first and foremost and we think that's where it shines. The chances we add a single player practice mode of some sort aren't zero, but we want to be clear that there is no single player in the game as of now. This may be a dealbreaker for some, but as the player pool increases and matchmaking becomes more reliable we hope it'll become less of an issue.

-Soft Serve Vanguard is the best skin and no one can convince us otherwise.

tl;dr hope you enjoy our game, join the discord, tell your friends, spin on!

With much love to our fans both old and new,
DreamSail Games

notes.title: PATCH 1.7 Released! Bringing you Team Modes!
notes.content:
PATCH 1.7
==========
+NEW GAME MODES! Introducing: Team Robomination and Team Overclocked! Team up and take down your opponents in unison. Which bots will work well together? Which bots won’t? That’s up to you to decide!
+GAME DEMO! We’re launching a free demo of Blade Ballet that includes the full game, but limited bots. Try out Blade Ballet with Torque, Catbot, and Ruckus! This will be available starting November 22nd.
+NEW SKINS! We’ve added some goofy new skins *spoiler alert* that fluffy Torque tho OMG
+SPIN ME RIGHT ROUND! You can spin your bots in the bot select screen now. The devs added this without telling anyone. Thanks, devs. 
========= 
BUGS BUGS BUGS 
=========
+Invisibility, no more. That invisibility bug that plagued us for so long is squashed. Even if you do somehow magically turn invisible, it will fix itself instead of bothering you for games on end.
+Can’t open skin box after quick teleporting to the ready platform - this is fixed!
+Non-winners respawn during win sequence in Overclocked if the point limit is hit
+Bunch of under-the-hood stuff for pushing team modes

notes.title: Patch 1.6 released!
notes.content:
Got a lot of bug fixes for ya, plus some shiny new skins, plus integration with Discord chat channels so you can see in-game what's going on in the community.

=========
PATCH 1.6
=========
+DISCORD INTEGRATION! What is that on the main menu? A bird, a plane? No...it’s Discord chat integration! You will now see a pulse of messages from the #bleep_bloop and #steam_looking _for_fight channels.
+MORE SKINS! We’ve added a number of new skins for each bot, including some bright ‘n popping streaming-themed designs.
+SCREEN OPTIONS! Now when you open the game, you’ll be prompted to make the game fullscreen, windowed, or borderless.
+REDUCED DISCONNECTIONS! We relaxed the timer on disconnects so even if a player’s connection to the server ain’t so great, they won’t be kicked from the game as frequently as they are now.
+GRAPHICAL FIXES! Sprinkled some finishing polish on Bitsburgh, plus many of the skins to make them perfecto.
=========
BUGS BUGS BUGS
=========
+The voice over in Soccer used to say “Start” instead of “Initialize.” That has been fixed.
+The UI got wonky at various smaller aspect ratios, we’ve gone through and fixed that.
+Not all the powerups had consistent text colors/fonts - how troublesome! That’s been fixed.
+The confetti position in match results was all goofed up so we decided to just replace it with stars, because why not? Now you’ve got sparkly stars that are much more elegant than any ol’ confetti!
+Abyss Steve had some crazy lighting that made him look more messy than cool, total ew. He looks a lot better now.
+Ruckus’ tail used to get caught in the air when he respawned which looked like some orange lightning striking the stage. This is fixed.
+Audio fixes: a variety of fixes to make things sound even better than they already do, including a fix for a horribly loud Ready platform noise caused by the sound triggering multiple times.
+The fan in Oa.sys no longer affects Nix’s illusion.
+Dropjaw exploit where newly respawned characters can be stunned has been fixed. Now invulnerability protects you from stun as well as damage.
+[PC Only] Fixed some issues with plugging/unplugging controllers, including seeing keyboard UI instead of controller UI even after a controller is plugged in, and having weirdness when equipping skins.
+[PS4 Only] Fixed a stutter on the Match Results screen that was caused by a dynamic text issue.

notes.title: Patch 1.5: Skins, New Stage, Crossplay
notes.content:
PATCH 1.5 
=========

This is a big one, folks. We’ve got content additions, major feature fixes, and more. 

+SKINS! We’ve added a skins system to Blade Ballet. Every bot now has a unique variety of unlockable skins. You unlock them by earning experience, and earn experience by winning games!
+NEW LEVEL! Once a useful mode of transportation, now a case of technology run haywire, Uploader has been added as a playable level. When the floor blinks….watch out.
+CROSSPLAY! PS4 and Steam will be separate in Matchmaking no more.
+MATCHMAKING FIX! No longer do you need a full group of four to start a matchmaking game, the minimum group is now 2 and the game will start after 60 seconds regardless of more people joining.
+POWER UPS! We made our power ups much, much more powerful. Become a spinning blender of death or a speedy robot of doom.
+TEAM SWITCHING! In Blade Ball, you can now manually choose your team. Who’s on for a game of 3 versus 1?
+ OA.SYS UPDATE! Players were getting stuck in the central area all the time and it was terrible, so we added a giant whirling fan to send bots flying into the air!  
+TURBO CLUB UPDATE! Scoring goals now awards a random powerup, because getting nearly-infinite invincibility was silly.
+SPAMMABLE TAUNTS! Taunts are now more spammable, and therefore more awesome.
+Quality of Life updates, including: Audio updates, fixed HUD placement,and a variety of bug fixes.

notes.title: Tournament #2 : Electric Bot-aloo
notes.content:
NEXT TOURNAMENT ANNOUNCEMENT! 
Our next tourney will be Tuesday Sept 13. I'm going to run this one a little differently so that the people in school, work, different time zones, etc will be able to take part. 

HOW IT WORKS
*We'll have three different time slots for the tournament - 11am, 3pm, and 6:30pm EST - you can sign up for any one of them. There should be at least 8 players in each time slot. 

*The finalists from each round will move on to compete in the Finals the following day at a time we find to work for all of us. As there will be 3 finalists, they will play round robin style: each of the three finalists will compete with each other and whoever has the most wins followed by the most kills in the case of a tie, will be crowned our first place winner. 

*Like last time, the fights will be 1v1, single elimination, hosted by me, and streamed to Twitch. 

*Sign up for the time slots can be found in our Discord (www.bladeballet.com/discord) in the Announcements channel so please head there to sign up

*The day before the tournament I'll make the brackets on Challonge

*If you do not show up for your match and don't notify me, you'll be disqualified and blocked from participating in whatever our next event is. It's not fair to your opponent when you don't show up, so please make sure if for whatever reason you can't make it you let me know before your time slot so I can reorganize the brackets. 

*Prizes will be: 1st place - $20 Steam game, 2nd - $15, and 3rd - $10. 

*If you have any issue with the Google form, you can friend me (booshumew) and message me or go into Discord and dm me your slot and username.

⚔ MAY THE BEST BOT WIN!!! ⚔

notes.title: Hotfix Update: Matchmaking
notes.content:
We know matchmaking isn't working as well as we wanted and hoped it would, it's so incredibly difficult to find anyone through it.

We're working on a slew of fixes to make this better. Today we're pushing an update that will cause ALL matchmaking games to connect to the US-Central server, which means everyone will be grouped together into one big pool instead of smaller, server-specific ones. We hope this creates a larger pool of players for the matchmaking to draw from so it'll be better and easier for you to find matches online. 

If you're far away from the Central US we know this means lower game quality (more lag, etc.), but know that this isn't necessarily a permanent change - we get a larger online playerbase, we can go back to a diverse range of servers to draw from for matchmaking. Plus, this WILL NOT affect Private matches at all, just matchmaking. 

If you guys have any questions you know you ask us here in the forums or on Discord! There will be more Matchmaking updates coming up soon, we apologize for how messy it is right now and know we're working hard to fix it.

notes.title: Blade Ballet Devlog: Level Design, Foxy STEVe, UI for Voting, and More
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SyNkCS2.jpg[/img]

In the beginning, our level design was really off-the-cuff, leading to the creation of some really cool levels - and some duds. We've streamlined our level design process to improve our success rate, testing all levels for fun pre-art and only putting levels in the game once they're proven to match our vision.

We love skins! Our bots have so much fun character that we can't wait to expand upon that with cool skin options (plus, it will make it easier to see which character you're playing). There's a lot of work that goes into implementing a skin system, so it's not in the game yet, but look for it in a future release.

We made UI for voting! An essential screen in any multiplayer game, this UI means you don't have to rely on the person who made the match to pick good game options.

[url=http://bladeballet.com/blog/2016/4/5/blade-ballet-devlog-level-design-foxy-steve]Read more about our recent progress here on our site![/url]

notes.title: Blade Ballet Devlog: Infected Effects, Mode Selects, 3D Objects, and More
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/NsCpvg2.jpg[/img]


Lately, we've been having fun prototyping new effects for our game - especially for a new, experimental mode called Zombie Mode. No confirmations on the mode entering the game yet, but we're ready with the effects when it's time!

We do, however, have new modes coming to the game very soon. So we had to make a mode select screen to choose between them!

We also 3D printed our very first bot. Really happy with how our bots look in IRL 3D!

[url=http://bladeballet.com/blog/2016/3/29/blade-ballet-devlog-infected-effects-mode-selects]Read the full update here on our site![/url]
